data.summary:
**When:** [Your Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), before one of your **ADEPTA SORORITAS TRANSPORT** models makes an [advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move).

**Target:** That **TRANSPORT** model.

**Effect:** You can re-roll the model's [Advance rolls](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move), and units embarked in it can [disembark](vsdata:core-rule/disembarking) even though it Advanced, for the rest of the turn. Disembarking this way counts as a **[Normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move)** for the unit, which then cannot declare a charge in that turn.
